chars.O: OUSSAMA: a skinny young Moroccan man wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie with a big black zipper, dark blue jeans and white sneakers
chars.K: KHADIJA: a young Moroccan woman wearing modest loose pastel-pink long-sleeve pyjamas with white polka dots and a big turquoise bath towel wrapped like a turban on her head

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: In the stairwell of a Casablanca duplex building, KHADIJA has just opened her apartment door and stands in the doorway with a surprised polite smile, one hand holding the towel on her head; OUSSAMA stands one step below on the stairs, frozen in shock with a comically wide-open mouth. Both clearly visible facing each other.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: KHADIJA in her doorway laughing in embarrassment, apologizing with a raised hand, a little steam from the bathroom behind her inside the flat; OUSSAMA on the landing staring at her, stiff as a statue, awkward.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Medium shot of OUSSAMA alone on the stair landing, extremely embarrassed, eyes wide, sweating drops on his bald head, hands stiff at his sides, a beige wall and a metal stair rail behind him.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: KHADIJA standing relaxed in the open doorway in her pyjamas and towel turban, smiling naturally; OUSSAMA in front of her turning his head away and looking up at the ceiling, cheeks blushing, comically awkward.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: OUSSAMA scratching his head with a confused blank look, a big question mark feeling, while KHADIJA waits in the doorway with her arms crossed, smiling and amused.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: OUSSAMA thanking KHADIJA with one hand on his chest and a shy grateful bow on the landing; KHADIJA nodding kindly in the doorway, a modern Casablanca apartment interior visible behind her.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: KHADIJA leaning on the door frame with a mysterious knowing smile; OUSSAMA facing her on the landing, nervously rubbing the back of his neck, unsure what she means.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: KHADIJA stepping back inside her flat and waving OUSSAMA in toward a Moroccan living room with low sofas; OUSSAMA hesitating at the threshold, one foot raised, nervous suspicious face. Tension and curiosity.
